description: This file defines a factory function to generate CRUD controllers for Mongoose models, including in-memory micro-caching for list endpoints, tenant-aware filtering, common error handling, and standard CRUD operations (list, getById, create, update, remove).

methods.name: microGet(key)
methods.description: Retrieves a cached list response if it exists and is not expired.

methods.name: microSet(key, payload)
methods.description: Stores a list response in the micro-cache with TTL.

methods.name: buildListKey(req, filter, sort, page, limit, skip, explicit)
methods.description: Constructs a cache key for list requests based on request parameters.

methods.name: mapAndReplyError(res, err, context = 'operation')
methods.description: Maps Mongoose errors to user-friendly HTTP responses.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles listing documents with optional in-memory caching, pagination, filtering, and tenant scoping.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a single document by ID with optional tenant scoping.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new document, stamping tenant ID if present.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a document by ID, considering tenant filtering if applicable.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a document by ID, considering tenant filtering if applicable.

ctags.name: buildListKey
ctags.pattern: /^function buildListKey(req, filter, sort, page, limit, skip, explicit) {$/

ctags.pattern: /^          const payload = { success: true, data: items, meta: { page, limit, total } };$/
